question: By what division of parts and head characteristics are liṅgas further distinguished?
premises: Parts beginning with Brahmā are used as a basis.
Distinction is made by head characteristics.
This distinction is applied in the same manner.
inference: Liṅgas are likewise distinguished by Brahmā and other parts according to differences in head marks.
plain_english: Likewise, by parts beginning with Brahmā, according to differences in head characteristics.
